name: io.github.Hugelidus/pointcast
title: Pointcast
description: Talk and Alt+click on your web app: your agent gets the exact elements and the code behind them.

environmentVariables.name: POINTCAST_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder the recordings are read from and stored in. Default: <Downloads>/pointcast.

environmentVariables.name: POINTCAST_HANDOFF
environmentVariables.description: Set to off to stop receiving recordings from the extension on 127.0.0.1:20547 (shared multi-user computers).
